items.title: Ball (BALL) Stock May Be Undervalued On Its 30% Five Year Slide
items.summary: Ball Corporation has delivered mixed share-price results over the past few years, which puts fresh focus on a simple question for investors who follow Ball stock. With the current price near US$60.71, is the market paying a sensible amount for the earnings the business is generating today? The share price is down about 30.0% over 5 years, which raises the issue of whether the current valuation still lines up with the company’s long term earnings power. items.title: 2 Mid-Cap Stocks with Exciting Potential and 1 We Question
items.summary: Mid-cap stocks often strike the right balance between having proven business models and market opportunities that can support $100 billion corporations.
